title: Write test vectors for group log CRDT merge and backfill
description:
Create a deterministic test scenario: build a 50-entry log on replica A, fork it into a 10-entry divergence on replica B, then run reconcile() and backfill() to merge. Assert final tip sets are identical. All data is in-memory (no IPFS required). Artifact: core/tests/group_log_vectors.rs.

Acceptance:
- Test is fully deterministic (fixed node_id, fixed wall clock)
- Both replicas converge to identical tip set after merge
- No network I/O in the test
- cargo test runs the test in under 5 seconds
